title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
shortDescription: Super Mario Bros. Wonder helps define a Nintendo Switch platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Places a source-linked platformer entry in the Nintendo Switch browsing path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Nintendo Switch platformer discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a catalog entry with its source kept explicit.
